title: Multi-agent state primitives in lib/
objective: Promote the multi-agent state patterns proven in today's messenger/agents hardening into shared library code and adopt them across extensions. Deliverables: (1) lib/session-identity.ts — persisted per-session identity via custom entries (env override, generate-once-and-persist semantics), adopted by messenger; (2) lib/presence-shards.ts — sharded presence registry with dead-pid pruning and legacy migration, adopted by messenger; (3) generalized orphan-TTL lock semantics, adopted by the agents worker registry to fix its crash gap (stuck-running records, lost reports); (4) tests + README updates for each adoption. Done means: all three primitives exist in lib/ with tests, messenger and agents use them instead of hand-rolled equivalents, npm run check green, no behavior change for existing users beyond the documented crash-gap fix.

tasks.title: Extract lib/session-identity.ts from messenger and adopt it

verification.command: npx vitest run test/extensions/messenger.test.ts && npm run validate:one extensions/messenger/messenger.ts

tasks.summary: lib/session-identity.ts extracted (env override → newest persisted custom entry → generate-and-persist), with 5 direct unit tests in test/lib/session-identity.test.ts (new directory). Messenger adopted it via resolveSessionIdentity(pi, ctx, { customType: "messenger-identity", envVar: "PI_MESSENGER_NAME", generate: resolveAgentName }) — persisted entries from before the refactor still resolve. Full check green: 37 files, 933 tests. Commit 611b749.

tasks.title: Extract lib/presence-shards.ts (sharded registry + legacy migration) and adopt it in messenger

verification.command: npx vitest run test/extensions/messenger.test.ts && npm run validate:one extensions/messenger/messenger.ts

tasks.summary: lib/presence-shards.ts extracted (shard-per-agent writes, readShard, removeShard, loadShards with dead-pid pruning + corrupt-shard dropping + legacy single-file migration, isProcessAlive), 9 direct unit tests. Messenger's loadRegistry/heartbeat/leaveRegistry now delegate to the lib; shard locations, filenames, and observable behavior unchanged (all 30 messenger tests green). Also noticed and cleaned two lint warnings from my own diff (unused import, string concat) before amending. Full check green: 38 files, 942 tests. Commit 21bc167.

tasks.title: Generalize orphan-TTL lock semantics and adopt in agents worker registry (fix crash gap)

verification.command: npx vitest run test/extensions/agents.test.ts && npm run validate:one extensions/agents/agents.ts

tasks.summary: Worker registry now reconciles on every read: any running record whose pid is dead is marked failed ("worker process is gone") — the crash gap (stuck-running records, stuck concurrency slots) is fixed without waiting for a session_start. Scope note: full orphan-TTL grace proved inapplicable — workers are one-shot processes that cannot resume, so reconcile-on-read (immediate) is the correct generalization; TTL-grace remains specific to resumable messenger identities. Bonus fix exposed by the new tests: saveWorker no longer lets a stale running snapshot overwrite a terminal record (pre-existing race). 944/944 tests. Commit d6776f4.

tasks.title: Update READMEs (messenger, agents, lib patterns) and run full check
tasks.summary: agents README now describes reconcile-on-read registry healing (any read, not just session_start); the shared-helpers skill documents lib/session-identity and lib/presence-shards with a quick-reference table row each, so future extensions adopt the primitives. Full check green. Commit 180779d (docs) + 5c0e24e (save serialization fixing the flaky delegate test found during this task).

checkpoints.label: Mission complete: state primitives in lib/
checkpoints.summary: All 4 tasks done. lib/session-identity.ts (persisted per-session identity, adopted by messenger, 611b749); lib/presence-shards.ts (sharded presence registry with prune/migration, adopted by messenger, 21bc167); worker-registry crash-gap fix via reconcile-on-read + per-cwd save serialization + terminal-record guard (d6776f4, 5c0e24e); docs updated (180779d). Full check green: 38 files, 946 tests. Bonus fixes along the way: autoresearch stall guard (7a91f73) and autoresearch discard data-loss (7ead990).

decisions.text: Original mission-mtulbjdz-d294 was destroyed mid-campaign by an autoresearch discard: discardAll staged everything (git add -A) and hard-reset, deleting all untracked non-ignored files including .pi/missions/. Root cause fixed in 7ead990 (init-time untracked snapshot; discards remove only experiment-created files). Mission recreated verbatim as mission-mtumm844-f327. Lesson recorded: untracked non-ignored state is unsafe during autoresearch campaigns on versions before 7ead990.
